contract.scope_policy: each evaluates on each confirmed selected object; document_group aggregates selected roles per document. Document-level absence checks run even if the missing structure has no selected node.
contract.role_membership_policy: A confirmed leaf role also matches its explicit transitive role_parents; generic selectors never require duplicate manual labels. Deduplicate by stable target ID. notification_policy.source_check_preserved: check records source requirements; audit defines executable subset, not all source assertions
notification_policy.override_semantics: audit.when adds conditions to rule.when; audit.roles replaces executable targets, including document-level missing-structure checks; audit.tests overrides check.tests for execution only, null uses original properties/assertions; audit.requires lists shared dependencies only. Other provider failures make only their own facts unknown, not all subchecks.
